description: Search FickelUSA custom promotional products (logo apparel, drinkware, bags, hats, pens and more). Returns up to 10 products with id, name, category, image and product page link. Use the id with get_product or request_quote.

limit.description: How many results to return (1 to 10, default 5).

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "travel mug", "embroidered polo", "tote bag".

name: search_catalog
